title: Postcards — Boids Background
description: post-cards/data/background/boids.json. Tuning for the envelope-flocking animation behind the postcard stage. Shared/environmental mechanics (flocking phases, wind, force limits) live at the top level; each entry in categories owns its own visual/behavioral traits (which shapes it draws from boids-shapes.json, how fast/large/wobbly it is, its color) and a spawn weight (higher = more common). herd/scatter give the alignment/cohesion/separation/perception values the whole flock drifts between over phasePeriodMs. wind is an ambient steering target so the flock drifts like paper on a breeze rather than flying under its own power.

flockSize.description: Total boid count across all categories.

shapeViewBox.description: The square SVG viewBox size (e.g. 512) every shape in boids-shapes.json is authored against.

wind.description: A slowly-wandering ambient direction every boid steers toward, alongside alignment/cohesion/separation.

angle.description: Base direction in radians (0 = rightward, increasing clockwise).

angleVariance.description: Radians the wind direction wanders either side of angle.

periodMs.description: Time for one full wander cycle.

weight.description: Steering weight toward the wind vector.

category.description: One kind of boid (e.g. envelope, letter, flower) with its own shapes, speed, wobble and color, and a spawn weight relative to the other categories.

weight.description: Spawn weight relative to other categories' weights (not normalized to any total).

shapeIds.description: Ids into boids-shapes.json's shapes map; a boid in this category picks one at random for visual variety.

iconSize.description: Rendered width/height in canvas pixels of a shapeViewBox x shapeViewBox box, before per-boid sizeScale.

speedPerNeighbor.description: Added to a boid's max speed for each flockmate currently within its perception radius.

rotationSmoothing.description: Per-frame lerp factor easing rotation toward its velocity heading; lower lags more, reading as carried rather than steered.

flutterAmplitude.description: Radians of sinusoidal wobble layered onto rotation.

flutterSpeed.description: Angular frequency of the flutter wobble, in radians per millisecond.

colorVar.description: A CSS custom property name (must resolve to a #rrggbb hex value) read from :root.

colorAlphaVariance.description: Fraction each boid's alpha is scaled up or down by (at spawn) around colorAlpha, keyed to the same per-boid depth as depthSpeedVariance so fainter boids are also the slower, further-back ones.

depthSpeedVariance.description: Fraction each boid's speed cap is scaled up or down by (at spawn), keyed to the same per-boid depth as colorAlphaVariance, for a parallax cue.

depthSizeVariance.description: Fraction each boid's size is scaled up or down by (at spawn) from the same per-boid depth as colorAlphaVariance/depthSpeedVariance, loosely echoing the parallax cue without locking size exactly to it.

sizeJitter.description: Additional fraction of independent random size variation layered on top of depthSizeVariance, so size doesn't track opacity exactly.
